$description: How a coop's cap table forms. Invested hearts are not burned: they convert one for one into maiaHEARTS, the city's common currency, which the coop's treasury holds to build with. In return the investor receives the coop's MINDs — its ownership currency. Milestones are counted in MINDs: milestone n is reached when the total supply is the n-th Fibonacci number of MINDs — 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 … — so it emits the difference to the milestone before, at a price of 10 × n hearts per MIND. The earliest believers pay the least per MIND; everyone inside one milestone pays the same price, like a round.

emission.$description: Of every MIND minted, this share goes to the investor; the rest to the coop's treasury. The treasury is already paid — it holds the maiaHEARTS — so the MINDs, the ownership, go to the people who backed it.

milestones.$description: Milestone n is filled when the total supply reaches fib(n) MINDs; it emits fib(n) − fib(n−1) MINDs at 10 × n hearts each — 10♥ in milestone 1, 20♥ in 2 — and opens once every earlier milestone is filled. The schedule runs until the max supply of 1.3 million MINDs: the last milestone emits only what is left under the cap, then the coop is sold out. A coop's total supply is always exactly what its milestones have emitted so far. The table is generated from the rule by scripts/coops-table.ts.
milestones.rule: total(n) = min(fib(n), maxSupply); minds(n) = total(n) - total(n-1); heartsPerMind(n) = n * heartsPerMindStep; cost(n) = minds(n) * heartsPerMind(n)

founding.$description: What it takes to open a coop: a pitch, the six-field canvas, and the founder's own first conversion of 500 hearts — the founding stake, which takes the coop through its first milestones on the founder's belief alone.

phases.$description: A coop's life in five phases, six milestones each; the last phase runs to the max supply at milestone 30.

signal.$description: The support signal a season is judged on — the number behind the real-world investment. Weights are tunable; the formula is public in the game. There is NO cap on how much one backer may invest: the signal weighs breadth and momentum instead.

city.$description: A card of the planet is unlocked by founding a city on it; a city is itself a coop, with the same milestones, whose MINDS carry the city's name. Becoming a citizen takes an investment of at least 25,000 personal hearts into the city — founding counts as the first. A player is a citizen of one city for good.

settlement.$description: The second step into a city. The city opens as an island of cells; a settlement is a village of domes on one of them, and itself a coop with its own MINDS. A citizen founds one, or joins one with an invite link from one of its settlers — at least 25,000 personal hearts either way, which become the city's HEARTS in the settlement's treasury. One settlement per player, for good. It grows by headcount through twelve levels, one for every Fibonacci number up to 233: a level is reached when the settlers reach its number, and it builds enough beds for everyone until the next. The buildings for each level are in game/island/villages.ts.

conversion.$description: What an investment does to the hearts: every personal heart invested is taken out of the investor's own currency and the same amount of maiaHEARTS is minted into the coop's treasury. One for one, in spendable units.
